configFiles.template:
log			on

hostname		"${Hostname}"
rcon_password		"${RconPassword}"
sv_password		"${PrivatePassword}"
sv_region		${sv_region}
sv_lan			${sv_lan}
sv_logbans		0
sv_logecho		0
sv_logfile		1 
sv_log_onefile		0
sv_noclipspeed		5
sv_noclipaccelerate	5

sbox_allownpcs		1
sbox_godmode		0
sbox_plpldamage		0
sbox_playergod		0
sbox_noclip		1

sbox_maxprops		150
sbox_maxragdolls	5
sbox_maxnpcs		10
sbox_maxballoons	10
sbox_maxeffects		50
sbox_maxdynamite	10
sbox_maxlamps		20
sbox_maxthrusters	30
sbox_maxwheels		20
sbox_maxhoverballs	20
sbox_maxvehicles	6
sbox_maxbuttons		20
sbox_maxsents		20
sbox_maxemitters	5
sbox_maxspawners	3
sbox_maxturrets		2

net_maxfilesize		30

sv_minrate		${sv_minrate} 
sv_maxrate		${sv_maxrate}
decalfrequency		10 
sv_maxupdaterate	66 
sv_minupdaterate	10 

// execute ban files
exec banned_ip.cfg 
exec banned_user.cfg

script.name: Extract Workshop Addon
script.description: Moves the downloaded Steam Workshop .gma into garrysmod/addons and extracts it with the game's gmad binary.

script.name: Remove Workshop Addon
script.description: Deletes the addon folder for an uninstalled Steam Workshop file from garrysmod/addons.
